SimCity for the @TITLE@
version @VERSION@
======================================================================

This is an unofficial port of SimCity (1989) to the @TITLE@.  The
simulation is the game's own: it comes from a disassembly of the ZX
Spectrum version, kept as it was, with the screen, keyboard, sound and
files of each machine written afresh. The Amiga, Atari ST and Amstrad CPC
versions supplied the pictures and sound effects used on some machines.

SimCity is (C) 1989 Maxis Software.  The Spectrum version is by Probe
Software, published by Infogrames.  The ports are built with z88dk.  The
source is at https://github.com/suborb/simcity_z80 .

This is a preservation and hobby project, given as is, with no
warranty.

What is in this zip
-------------------
@FILES@

Playing
-------
The city is the map you see; the cursor is a square on it.  Choose a
tool, move the cursor and build.  Zones need power, roads and rails
carry the people, and the city grows where it is wanted.

The three bars R, C and I show how much of each kind of zone is wanted:
residential, commercial and industrial.  A bar growing to the right of the
middle mark means more of that zone is wanted, to the left means there is
too much of it.  The advisor message says what is needed most.

The game starts by asking for a level (1 easy, 2 medium, 3 hard).  Once a
year, in December, the budget comes up so that you can set the tax rate
and the money for transport, police and fire; the budget can also be run
for you (Auto-budget in the options).  The evaluation says how the mayor
is doing.

A power plant costs $3000 (coal) or $5000 (nuclear); a fire, flood,
earthquake, air crash, tornado or meltdown can be started from the
disasters menu, or can happen by themselves (they can be switched off).
